findings.description: Institutional record continuity gap — the artifacts from Prompts 62-71 (G0/G1 baseline, corridor decision, bank pipeline, counsel package, executive package, bank workshop, pilot term sheet, assurance framework) are not present on the current filesystem. The environment was reset to git commit e14a82a (on top of 8e13d05 v25.6). The worklog is at 8,717 lines ending at the v25.6/E2-A (Foundry cast removal) era; the Prompt 70 worklog append (which brought the worklog to 12,242 lines) is absent. The Prompt 70 work was uncommitted and was lost when the environment was reset.
findings.evidence: Filesystem inspection: /institutional/ does not exist; worklog wc -l = 8717; git HEAD = e14a82a; git reflog shows no Prompt 70 commit.
findings.impact: The institutional record cannot support any decision beyond NOT_YET_DETERMINED because (a) the prior prompt artifacts are not present to be re-examined, and (b) the upstream blocker (Pilot A never executed) means no execution evidence exists regardless. This finding does not change the outcome (which is NOT_YET_DETERMINED regardless) but is a material governance gap that must be remediated before any future institutional decision can rely on the repository as a continuous record.
findings.remediation: Restore the prior institutional artifacts from any available backup, OR re-create them from the conversation history of prior sessions. The /institutional/assurance/ directory (42 files from Prompt 70) and the /institutional/{g1,corridors,banks,legal,bank-workshop,pilot}/ directories from Prompts 62-69 must be present on the filesystem before any future institutional decision can reference them.
